title: Onboard Aurora Lite 5B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add Aurora Lite 5B v1.0 to model registry with metadata and verified performance profiles; automate changelog entry generation for future model onboards.
description: Context: Add Aurora Lite 5B v1.0 to the model registry with validated perf profiles and automated changelog entry generation. Motivation: customers and internal benchmarks require a lightweight 5B variant with predictable latency/cost profiles; automating changelog entries reduces manual bookkeeping and speeds model releases. What I changed: 1) Added metadata file registry/models/aurora-lite/5b/v1.0/metadata.json with schema fields (model_id, architecture, tokenizer, quantization_recommendation, default_config). 2) Added perf profiles registry/perf/aurora-lite-5b-v1.0.json with measured p50/p95 latencies and throughput targets for common sequence lengths and batch sizes; profiles include hardware tags (A100-40GB, T4, RTX6000) and recommended quantization presets. 3) Hooked the changelog automation: scripts/registry_changelog/generate_entry.py now ingests new model metadata and emits a draft release note in docs/models/CHANGELOG.md. 4) Updated model-catalog index to include aurora-lite-5b:v1.0. Checklist: - [x] Metadata JSON validated against schema - [x] Perf profiles produced from perf-lab runs and signed off by perf team - [x] Changelog generation script integrated into CI job - [x] Docs entry generated and smoke-checked - [x] Added unit tests for changelog parser Commits summary: (1) Add metadata and index entry (2) Add perf profile JSON (3) Add changelog generator and unit tests (4) Fix CI config for new job Files changed (high level): registry/models/aurora-lite/5b/v1.0/metadata.json, registry/perf/aurora-lite-5b-v1.0.json, docs/models/CHANGELOG.md (auto-generated draft), scripts/registry_changelog/generate_entry.py, tests/test_changelog_generator.py, model-catalog/index.json Review thread summary: Liam requested clearer quantization recommendations for T4 and A100 (commented: "please call out recommended int8 vs q4_0 and note accuracy tradeoffs"); author replied with updated metadata and an explanatory note in the perf JSON; Priya asked for a short note in CHANGELOG that includes the perf numbers used for release; Diego flagged a flaky unit test in CI which I fixed by adding a deterministic timestamp stub. CI history: initial CI run reported one flaky unit test failure (tests/test_changelog_generator.py::test_timestamped_entry) which was fixed in commit 3 and rerun. Final CI status: pass on main matrix, perf-lab artifacts uploaded and linked. Merging: approved by Liam and Priya after changes; merged via squash on 2026-02-18. Notes for ops: Perf profiles are conservative defaults; teams can pin alternate profiles in Dedicated. Follow-ups: (a) schedule perf regression eval for aurora-lite-5b during next weekly canary runs (ENG-5123), (b) add automated inference cost estimate to generated changelog entries (future PR).
